newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures steady in dull trade.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery was steady at 1,115 rupees per quintal on Wednesday after opening 3.50 rupees higher on stray buying, traders said.
In edible oils, groundnut oil fell three rupees to 366 rupees per 10 kgs. It was steady at 368/369 rupees per 10 kg on Tuesday.
In Rajkot, groundnut oil was lower by two rupees at 568 rupees per 15 kg.
Palm oil lost two rupees to 293 rupees per 10 kg on reports of the arrival of a consignment of 3,000 tonnes from Malaysia.
